Fixed issue with achievements not unlocking
 Improved support for Steam Deck

notes.title: RESEARCH and DESTROY 9/27 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the entire map could become purple, blocking progress.

notes.title: RESEARCH and DESTROY Patch 1.2 "Statistically Significant Update"
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738524/cd3d79ad3bda80577a8d0645f61a1816e94181b1.pngThis update adds a wide variety of features and improvements requested by fans, in addition to numerous fixes and optimizations.

Patch Notes:
●	“Opt-in” attack cameras
●	Multiplayer is now unlocked from the start
●	Some color-blindness correction options
●	Per-player difficulty level
●	Additional video options
●	Network optimization
●	General bug fixes and optimization
